Terms & Conditions | Sindhu’s Pickles

Last Updated: November 2025

Welcome to Sindhu’s Pickles (“we,” “our,” “us”).
By accessing or purchasing from sindhuspickles.com, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms & Conditions.
Please read them carefully before using our website or placing an order.

1. General Overview

Sindhu’s Pickles operates the website sindhuspickles.com to sell homemade non-vegetarian pickles and related food products across India.

By using our website, you:

  • Acknowledge that you are 18 years or older

  • Agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information

  • Accept these Terms and our Privacy Policy

If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website.

2. Products and Availability

  • All products displayed on our website are subject to availability.

  • We make every effort to accurately display product images and descriptions, but actual products may vary slightly in color or texture due to natural ingredients and handmade preparation.

  • We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products without prior notice.

3. Orders and Payments

  • Orders can be placed directly through sindhuspickles.com.

  • You must provide correct billing, delivery, and contact details.

  • Payments are processed securely via trusted gateways like Razorpay / Paytm / UPI / Debit & Credit Cards / Net Banking.

  • We reserve the right to cancel any order suspected of fraudulent activity.

4. Pricing

  • All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless mentioned otherwise.

  • We may update prices at any time without prior notice.

  • The price at the time of purchase will apply to your order.

5. Shipping and Delivery

  • We deliver across most locations in India using reputed courier partners.

  • Estimated delivery time: 3–7 business days (depending on your location).

  • Delivery delays caused by courier partners, weather, or unforeseen events are beyond our control.

  • You will receive tracking details once your order is shipped.

6. Return, Replacement & Refund Policy

Because our non-veg pickles are perishable food items, we do not accept returns or exchanges once the product is delivered.

However, we do offer replacements or refunds only in the following cases:

  • You receive a damaged or wrong product

  • You report the issue within 24 hours of delivery

  • You provide clear photo/video proof via email to info@sindhuspickles.com

Our team will review and process eligible refunds within 5–7 business days.

7. Use of Website

You agree not to:

  • Use the website for illegal or unauthorized purposes

  • Attempt to hack, modify, or disrupt our services

  • Post or transmit any malicious or harmful content

Violation of these terms may lead to suspension or permanent ban from our website.

8. Intellectual Property

All content on sindhuspickles.com, including text, logos, photos, and product descriptions, is the property of Sindhu’s Pickles and protected under Indian copyright laws.
You may not copy, distribute, or reproduce any content without written permission.

9. Limitation of Liability

Sindhu’s Pickles is not responsible for:

  • Allergic reactions or health issues resulting from consumption (please check ingredients before use)

  • Delays or failures caused by events beyond our control

  • Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages

All our pickles are prepared hygienically using traditional methods, but customers consume at their own discretion.

10. Governing Law

These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of India.
Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts located in Tamil Nadu, India.

11.Contact Us

For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, contact us:

Sindhu’s Pickles
 Email: Info@sindhuspickles.com
 Website: https://sindhuspickles.com
 Location: 1-1/154 Indhra Nagar, Mohan Nagar Post, Salem -636030.

Privacy Policy | Sindhu’s Pickles

Last Updated: November 2025

Welcome to Sindhu’s Pickles (referred to as “we,” “our,” or “us”).
We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit sindhuspickles.com or purchase our non-veg pickles and other food products online.

1. Information We Collect

A. Personal Information

When you place an order or create an account, we may collect:

  • Full Name

  • Email Address

  • Phone Number

  • Shipping & Billing Address

  • Payment Information (processed via secure third-party gateways)

B. Non-Personal / Technical Information

We also collect non-identifiable data such as:

  • Browser type and version

  • IP address

  • Device details

  • Pages visited and time spent

This helps us improve our services and website performance.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information to:

  • Process and deliver your pickle orders

  • Communicate order updates and confirmations

  • Improve our website and product quality

  • Send offers and promotions (only if you opt in)

  • Provide customer service and support

We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party.

3. Payment and Security

Your online transactions are protected using SSL encryption.
Payments are processed securely through Razorpay / Paytm / UPI / Net Banking / Credit & Debit Cards.
We do not store your payment details (such as card numbers or CVV) on our servers.

4. Cookies Policy

Our website uses cookies to:

  • Store your preferences

  • Track cart and checkout progress

  • Analyze website traffic and improve performance

You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some parts of the website may not function properly if you do.

5. Third-Party Services

We may share limited information with trusted third parties such as:

  • Payment gateways (for transaction processing)

  • Delivery partners (for order shipment)

  • Analytics tools (like Google Analytics)

  • Email or SMS providers (for order updates)

These services are bound by confidentiality agreements and data protection obligations.

6. Data Retention

We keep your data only as long as necessary to:

  • Complete transactions

  • Comply with legal requirements

  • Improve our business operations

If you wish to delete your data, please contact us — we’ll remove it unless required by law to retain it.

7. Your Rights

You have full control over your data. You may:

  • Request access to your personal information

  • Ask for corrections or updates

  • Withdraw consent for marketing emails

  • Request deletion of your data

To exercise these rights, email us at Info@sindhuspickles.com

8. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices.
The latest version will always be available on this page. Please review it regularly.

9. Contact Us

For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, contact us:

Sindhu’s Pickles
📧 Email: Info@sindhuspickles.com
🌐 Website: https://sindhuspickles.com
📍 Location: 1-1/154 Indhra Nagar, Mohan Nagar Post, Salem -636030

Shipping, Return & Refund Policy | Sindhu’s Pickles

Last Updated: November 2025

Thank you for shopping at Sindhu’s Pickles.
We aim to deliver fresh, homemade non-vegetarian pickles and food products safely and on time.
Please read our Shipping, Return, and Refund Policy carefully before placing your order.

1. Shipping Policy

Processing Time

  • Orders are processed within 2–3 business days after payment confirmation.

  • We prepare each batch fresh to maintain quality, so minor delays may occur during peak seasons or festivals.

  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

Shipping Charges

  • Shipping fees are calculated automatically at checkout based on your order weight and delivery location.

  • Any applicable delivery charges or offers (like free shipping) will be displayed before you complete payment.

Delivery Time

  • Estimated delivery time is 3–5 business days after dispatch, depending on your location.

  • Rural or remote areas may take slightly longer.

  • We partner with reliable courier services to ensure timely delivery, but delays due to logistics or natural events are beyond our control.

Order Tracking

  • Once your order is shipped, you will receive an email and/or SMS with your tracking ID and courier details.

  • You can track your shipment status through the provided link.

2. Return and Replacement Policy

No Returns or Exchanges

  • Due to the perishable nature of our food products, we do not accept returns or exchanges once an order is delivered.

  • Please review your order details carefully before confirming your purchase.

Damaged or Incorrect Products

  • We take the utmost care to package every pickle jar securely.

  • However, if your order arrives damaged, leaked, or incorrect, please contact us within 24 hours of delivery.

  • Send the following details to info@sindhuspickles.com:

    • Your order number

    • Photos or videos clearly showing the damaged/incorrect items

    • A brief description of the issue

Our quality team will investigate and, if the issue is verified, we’ll offer a replacement or refund at our discretion.

3. Refund Policy

Refund Eligibility

Refunds are applicable only in the following cases:

  1. Non-delivery of order (verified through courier tracking)

  2. Damaged or incorrect product (after investigation and proof)

We do not issue refunds for:

  • Customer mistakes in address entry or order confirmation

  • Dislike of taste, texture, or personal preferences

  • Products returned without prior communication or approval

Refund Process

  • Once approved, refunds will be initiated within 5 business days.

  • The amount will be credited to your original payment method (Razorpay, Paytm, UPI, Card, or Net Banking).

  • You will receive an email notification once your refund is processed.

4. Cancellation Policy

  • Orders can be canceled within 6 hours of placing the order by emailing info@sindhuspickles.com.

  • Once the product is shipped or processed, cancellations are not possible.

  • If a payment was made and the order is canceled in time, a full refund will be issued within 5 business days.

5. Responsibility & Disclaimer

  • We ensure hygienic preparation, packaging, and dispatch of all non-veg pickles.

  • Sindhu’s Pickles is not responsible for delays caused by courier partners, incorrect shipping details, or unforeseen natural events.

  • Please store pickles as per instructions on the label for best quality and shelf life.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding shipping, replacement, or refunds, please reach out to us:

Sindhu’s Pickles
📧 Email: info@sindhuspickles.com
📞 Phone: +91 88380 83381
🌐 Website: https://sindhuspickles.com
📍 Location: Tamil Nadu, India

We’re happy to assist you Monday–Saturday, 10 AM – 6 PM.
